title: Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated ‘Odyssey’
hook_text: Grok released seven minutes of Odyssey
script:
Grok just dropped the first seven minutes of its new AI-generated Odyssey.
The footage looks totally fine as long as you are not seeking artistry.
It also lacks inspiration and any real trace of human interest.
TechCrunch published the first look at how this generated film holds up.
Studio executives and independent creators are watching these early generative video tests closely now.
Would you sit through a feature length film made entirely by an algorithm?
